title: Deleting an account or content never deletes the stored files
standards: Ethiopia Proclamation 1321/2024 (right to erasure) — confirm with counsel
expected: Account deletion (and deletion of posts, stories, verification requests) removes or schedules removal of the uploaded objects they reference.
actual: anonymizeAccount() deletes and anonymises database rows, but no code path deletes storage objects (no DeleteObject / storage delete / unlink calls in backend source). Avatars, post media, verification selfies and ID documents remain at their public URLs after the account is gone.
impact: Erasure requests are incomplete; together with F-013, deleted users' ID documents stay publicly reachable indefinitely.
fix: Collect object keys before deleting rows (profiles, posts, stories, messages attachments, verification_requests), delete them in the same job (or enqueue a durable deletion job with retries), and add a periodic orphan sweep. Document the retention of files in docs/compliance/DATA_GOVERNANCE.md.
